versions.changelog: La skill puente ahora se llama f100k-puente

Initial release of Storytelling Animado — FÓRMULA 100K

- Transforms a raw story into a ready-to-record 9:16 reel of 45–90s, including script, animated explainer clips (via Higgsfield presets), and a synchronized MANIFEST.
- Delivers GUION.md, generated clips, and MANIFEST.md in entregables/storytelling/ for further editing.
- Interactive intake with up to 5 targeted questions to extract key story details, ensuring accurate context and vocabulary for any industry.
- Visual beats are selected using explainer animation presets (Claymotion, Stickman, etc.) if Higgsfield is connected—plan and cost approved before generation.
- Only activates for actual stories requiring narrative structure; not for lists, opinions, tutorials, long YouTube content, or ads.
- Integrates required templates and reference files for narrative arcs and visual support.
